title: VPN disconnects every few minutes
fix: Open the VPN client, go to Settings, and switch the protocol from UDP to TCP. Reconnect. If it still drops, restart the laptop once.

title: Cannot connect to office printer
fix: Remove the printer and re-add it using its IP address, not its name. Printer IPs are listed on the label on the printer itself.

title: Password expired or account locked
fix: Go to the self-service password portal and choose Unlock account. You need your registered phone for the one-time code.

title: Outlook keeps asking for password
fix: Close Outlook. Open Credential Manager, remove all entries starting with MicrosoftOffice. Reopen Outlook and sign in once.

title: Teams audio not working in meetings
fix: In Teams, open Settings, Devices, and make sure the correct microphone is selected. On macOS also check System Settings, Privacy, Microphone, and allow Teams.

title: Laptop very slow after update
fix: Restart the laptop twice. Post-update indexing usually finishes within an hour. If still slow after that, file a ticket.

title: Second monitor not detected
fix: Unplug the dock from the laptop, wait 10 seconds, plug it back in. On Windows press Win+P and choose Extend.

title: Wi-Fi connected but no internet
fix: Forget the corporate Wi-Fi network and reconnect. If the problem is only in one meeting room, report the room name in a ticket.

title: Shared drive not mapping
fix: Connect to VPN first, then open File Explorer and reconnect the drive. Shared drives are only reachable on VPN or in the office.

title: Software install blocked by policy
fix: Standard users cannot install software directly. Request it through the Software Center. Anything not listed there needs a ticket with business justification.
